blocks.raw: <Tip>Special housing = tailored to population needs. IPs require FPIC + ancestral land priority. PWDs require universal accessible design. Disaster housing requires speed + livelihood restoration.</Tip>

blocks.raw: <WikiMistakeList mistakes={["Confusing FPIC (Free, Prior, Informed Consent) requirement with simple consultation (FPIC is a legal requirement for IP projects; consultation alone is insufficient)","Assuming special housing programs are larger than mainstream socialized housing (they are actually smaller and often underfunded)","Forgetting that disaster housing must address livelihood restoration (not just shelter provision)","Treating accessible design as optional add-on (it is mandatory under RA 7277 for PWDs)","Believing IP housing must replicate traditional architecture (FPIC and cultural respect do not preclude modern design; they ensure community participation)"]} />
